lessons.title: 时间、条件、让步与结果状语从句

questions.stem: You won't pass the exam ____ you work harder.
questions.explain: unless = if…not（除非，如果不）：如果不更努力就考不过。用“if”意思就变成“更努力反而考不过”，不合逻辑。
questions.verify: 本单元按“状语从句与连接词”编写，教材各单元的语法项目未核实；请对照教材目录核对。

questions.stem: He was ____ tired that he fell asleep at once.
questions.explain: so + 形容词 / 副词 + that… 表示“如此……以至于……”；such 后面接名词短语。

questions.stem: It was ____ a fine day that we decided to go for a picnic.
questions.explain: such + a / an + 形容词 + 名词 + that…；如果用 so，语序要变成 so fine a day。

questions.stem: I had hardly got home ____ it began to rain.
questions.explain: hardly / scarcely…when… 和 no sooner…than… 都表示“一……就……”，搭配固定，不能混用。

questions.stem: ____ it was raining heavily, they went on working in the field.
questions.explain: 下大雨和继续干活之间是转折让步关系，用 although（虽然）。注意 although 和 but 不能同时使用。

questions.kp: 条件状语从句：as long as
questions.stem: You can borrow my car ____ you bring it back by six.
questions.explain: as long as 意为“只要”，表示条件：只要六点前还车就可以借。“in case”表示“以防”，意思不通。

questions.stem: No sooner had he arrived ____ he was asked to leave again.
questions.explain: No sooner…than… 表示“一……就……”，放在句首时主句要部分倒装（had he arrived）。

questions.stem: He speaks English ____ well that people think he is a native speaker.
questions.explain: 空格后是副词 well，再接 that 从句，用 so…that…（如此……以至于……）。

lessons.title: 目的、方式状语从句与逻辑连接词

questions.stem: He works hard ____ he can support his family.
questions.explain: so that 引导目的状语从句，从句里常有 can / could / may：努力工作是为了养家。

questions.stem: She talks ____ she knew everything about the matter.
questions.explain: as if / as though 意为“好像”；从句用过去式 knew，是虚拟语气，表示与现在事实相反（她其实并不全知道）。

questions.stem: Take an umbrella with you ____ it rains.
questions.explain: in case 意为“以防，万一”：带伞是以防下雨。“unless”会变成“除非下雨才带伞”，意思相反。

questions.stem: The plan sounds good. ____, we don't have enough money to carry it out.
questions.explain: 前一句肯定计划，后一句说没钱实施，是转折关系，用 However。“Besides”表示递进，用于同一方向的补充。

questions.stem: He didn't study hard; ____, he failed the exam.
questions.explain: 不努力是原因，考试不及格是结果，用 as a result（结果，因此）。in addition 表示补充，on the other hand 表示对比。

questions.stem: Some people like coffee, ____ others prefer tea.
questions.explain: while 在这里表示对比（而），把两类人的不同喜好放在一起比较。

questions.stem: ____ the bad weather, the match went on as planned. (despite / although)
questions.explain: despite 是介词，后面接名词短语 the bad weather；although 是连词，后面要接从句（Although the weather was bad…）。

questions.stem: Hurry up, ____ you'll miss the train.
questions.explain: “祈使句 + or + 陈述句”表示“……否则……”；表示“……那么就……”用 and。
